headline: Ashish Kacholia adds three new stocks and increases two existing stakes
hook: Ace investor reshuffles Q2 portfolio holdings
summary: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia updated his portfolio in the second quarter of 2027. He increased his holdings in Indo SMC and Stove Kraft. Additionally, he initiated new positions in ESDS Software Solutions, Ardee Industries, and Credent Connect N Care. These moves reflect his current strategy in response to shifting market trends.
why_it_matters: Retail investors often track ace investor moves for stock ideas.
